title: Mob Lynching and Road Accident Reported in Patna
summary: In Patna, a mob lynching incident resulted in the death of one individual and serious injury to another. Separately, a road accident involving a truck collision with a mother and son's vehicle led to their deaths and injuries to four others. The coverage focuses on these two distinct events occurring in the city.
summary_points: One person died and another was seriously injured in a mob lynching in Patna.
A road accident in Patna involving a truck killed a mother and son.
Four other individuals were injured in the road accident.
The coverage details these two separate incidents in Patna.

summary_points_hi: पटना में मॉब लिंचिंग में एक व्यक्ति की मौत और दूसरा गंभीर रूप से घायल हुआ।
